ember.name: Ember
ember.desc: A ball of fire. Where it lands, the ground burns for a few seconds.

pyre.name: Pyre
pyre.desc: The same fireball, with far less restraint. A wider, longer fire.

spray.name: Spray
spray.desc: A ball of water thrown hard enough to go straight through a line of bodies.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.desc: Enough water, moving fast enough, to knock a rank over.

shardshot.name: Sharpstone
shardshot.desc: A stone thrown low and hard. It bursts a moment after it lands.

upheaval.name: Upheaval
upheaval.desc: The ground opens where it stops. Slow, and worth the wait.

gust.name: Gust
gust.desc: Fast, light, and it carries whatever it hits backwards with it.

galewind.name: Galewind
galewind.desc: A line of moving air with an edge on it.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.desc: A jet of flame for as long as there is mana. Light is a wide cone at arm's length; heavy is narrow, and reaches three times as far.

flame_ring.name: Flame Ring
flame_ring.desc: A ring of fire round where you stand. What is inside it with you has to come through it to get out.

wall_of_fire.name: Wall of Fire
wall_of_fire.desc: A wall of burning ground across the way you are facing, for five seconds. It does not care which side anything is on.

hydro_cannon.name: Hydro Cannon
hydro_cannon.desc: One great ball of water, thrown hard. What it hits is soaked, and goes a long way backwards.

tidal_wave.name: Tidal Wave
tidal_wave.desc: A wave seven wide that rolls out slowly through everything, soaking it and carrying it along.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.desc: Water turning where your target stands, for four seconds. It drags whatever is in it to the middle and holds it there.

slabstrike.name: Slabstrike
slabstrike.desc: A square of the ground torn up and swung at whatever is in front of you. A heavy blow tears up a bigger one and swings it the same way, slower; held and let go, that one is carried over your quarry and dropped on them, where it breaks. What it hits is thrown, and often concussed.

sedimentary_rain.name: Sedimentary Rain
sedimentary_rain.desc: Stones, coming down on a circle for two seconds and more. Each volley is its own roll to hit on whatever is still under it.

mineral_burst.name: Mineral Burst
mineral_burst.desc: Eight sharp stones, one after another, faster than they can be counted.

tornado.name: Tornado
tornado.desc: A whirl of air that walks where you sent it, throwing whatever it catches in any direction it likes; the further it is thrown, the more it is hurt. A light cast is a dust devil. Held and let go, it lasts four seconds.

air_slash.name: Air Slash
air_slash.desc: An edge of air as wide as a doorway, that goes through everything in its way and is gone.

turbulence.name: Turbulence
turbulence.desc: The air round you for three seconds is not to be stood in: everything near is thrown about, again and again.

eldritch_blast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritch_blast.desc: A beam of crackling force out of the oldest books. It passes through whatever it strikes and throws the rest back.
eldritch_blast.taught_by: Magister Orrin teaches it at the college in Fernhollow.

acid_spray.name: Acid Spray
acid_spray.desc: Five gouts of acid in a fan, at arm's length and a little more. What they splash is poisoned: it sickens for six seconds, and its hide gives way while it does.
acid_spray.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.desc: Three darts of light that turn after whatever you are fighting. They have never been known to miss.
magic_missile.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

ice_touch.name: Ice Touch
ice_touch.desc: Talons of ice grown from your own hand and raked across whatever is in front of you. What they open is chilled -- slow in its legs and in its arm -- and if it is soaked, it freezes where it stands.
ice_touch.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

scorching_ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching_ray.desc: Three rays of heat in a fan, faster than anything the elements throw.
scorching_ray.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

vampiric_touch.name: Vampiric Touch
vampiric_touch.desc: A claw of your own blood, thrown out at the end of your arm and raked across them. Half of what it takes comes back to you as health. There is no status in it: it is a way of staying up.
vampiric_touch.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

hail_of_blades.name: Hail of Blades
hail_of_blades.desc: A moment after the word is said, a swarm of conjured blades turns over whatever you are fighting and everything beside it, and falls on them.
hail_of_blades.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

hellish_rebuke.name: Hellish Rebuke
hellish_rebuke.desc: Fire where they stand, at once, and it leaves them burning. Cast within four seconds of being hurt it is an answer, and lands half as hard again.
hellish_rebuke.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

cloud_of_daggers.name: Cloud of Daggers
cloud_of_daggers.desc: A slow orb that bursts into a cloud of spinning knives where it lands, and hangs there cutting for a few seconds.
cloud_of_daggers.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.desc: A ring of force out of the caster in every direction at once, that throws everything it touches.
thunderwave.taught_by: The college in Fernhollow sells the tome.
